@cloudbase/database.reason: CloudBase SDK 4.0.2 currently pins database 1.4.3. Application repositories use fixed field paths and validated DTOs rather than caller-controlled lodash paths.

@cloudbase/node-sdk.reason: This is the current SDK chain required by wx-server-sdk 4.0.2. CloudBase endpoints and request shapes are fixed by server-side adapters.

axios.reason: Axios 0.27.2 is internal to the pinned CloudBase SDK. Application-controlled arbitrary URLs, proxy settings, headers, and axios config objects are not passed into that SDK.

lodash.set.reason: The transitive CloudBase database adapter receives fixed repository field paths; client input is normalized before repository calls.

lodash.unset.reason: The transitive CloudBase database adapter receives fixed repository field paths; client input is normalized before repository calls.

wx-server-sdk.reason: npm reports the wrapper because of the transitive CloudBase chain. Version 4.0.2 is the current upstream release and is pinned exactly.
